title: Parallel work needs independence
summary: Parallel branches can run independent checks at the same time. They should not accidentally change the same temporary files.
introduction: Parallel branches can run independent checks at the same time. They should not accidentally change the same temporary files. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.
learningObjectives: Use the example to answer a practice question

blocks.text: Parallel branches can run independent checks at the same time. They should not accidentally change the same temporary files.

blocks.title: Parallel work needs independence

blocks.text: The branches describe two independent checks. This fragment belongs in a declarative pipeline's stages.

items: Read the example from top to bottom. Point to the part that uses the new idea.
Name two tasks that cannot safely run together.
Explain what changed in your own words. Check the example again if you get stuck.

blocks.title: A common mistake
blocks.text: Parallel steps that share mutable files can interfere with each other.
For more detail later, use this [Jenkins further reading](https://www.jenkins.io/doc/book/pipeline/).
